title: mentha sylvestris var. hirta
intro: Mentha sylvestris var. hirta, commonly known as woolly mint or hairy mint, is a variety of mint plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is prized for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha sylvestris var. hirta include its use as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
